stem: Although both HF and HCl are hydrogen halides, HF has a much higher boiling point because: (a) Fluorine has smaller atomic size than chlorine (b) HF molecules are heavier than HCl molecules (c) HF molecules are associated through hydrogen bonding (d) H—F bond length is greater than H—Cl bond length
answer: c HF molecules are associated through hydrogen bonding

stem: CF 4 , SF 4 and XeF 4 contain the following electronic structure on their central atoms. Which one is the correct option?
